narrative: Weekend reports of Omani-mediated talks to restore Strait of Hormuz navigation dominate headlines, offering a potential reprieve from geopolitical risk ahead of the Tokyo open. While the NZD/USD bilateral theme remains critical (NZD 1W avg: +1.343%, USD 1W avg: -1.331%, G10 spread: 2.674%), any de-escalation may curb the USD's safe-haven appeal and support the JPY. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1678 and faces a technical test at the 1.1634 SMA200, while USD/JPY closed at 158.86 with strong put skew (RR -1.96) signaling downside risk into the open. Market focus shifts to Tuesday's SEK interest rate decision for the first major key catalyst of the week.
